messages:
rafael_pm: quick sync thread to land a 'pin lifecycle bridge' proposal. goal: combine onboarding acceptance gates with a post-onboard TTL and a controlled migration path that minimizes customer surprise. want to lock minimum launch criteria and communication flow.

zoe_se: short version: provide a "soft-hold" state for pins so SEs can request a hold when customer is in active migration. we also need a clear signal for 'one-click rollback' in Console.

marcus_research: proposal: two-stage acceptance during onboarding: 1) functional bench (onboard-functional, ~20 prompts) 2) stability bench (onboard-stability, embed anchors + perf samples). both must pass to mark model as "GA-servable" for pinning. include a 'acceptance_token' that records bench_version + thresholds.

eden_support: comms: tenants should see a "pin status" timeline: onboarded -> pinned -> TTL-warning -> scheduled-migration -> migrating -> migrated. notify at 45d/21d/7d. Provide preview canary and an 'opt into migration credit' CTA. also surface contract exemptions automatically.

tina_engineering: infra notes: need to track per-tenant KV-cache heatmap to estimate canary noise. default canary sizing: 1% or min(1k reqs/day, 5% traffic) with synthetic warmups. phased promotion plan: 5% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% with health checks after each step.

rafael_pm: draft minimum launch gates (for auto-migrate mode): - acceptance_token present from onboarding - nightly canary pass on onboard-stability (3 runs, median pass) - p99 latency delta <= 2% absolute - embed cosine drift <= 1% mean - automated rollback signal on any of above failing. Also gated by legal/contractary opt-out.

zoe_se: console UX idea: in pin detail show last acceptance_token, last_canary_summary, and a timeline with an inline "preview diffs" that shows top 5 changed responses for golden prompts. include a "request hold" and "run canary now" button.

marcus_research: metric definitions I'll add: semantic_delta = 1 - mean(semantic_score(golden_pairs)); embed_drift = mean(1 - cosine(anchor_old, anchor_new)); quality_flag = semantic_delta > 0.04 || embed_drift > 0.01. bench runner will annotate runs with run_id, bench_version, seed_prefixes.

eden_support: comms templates: 45d notice = informational; 21d = preview available; 7d = migration scheduled unless opt-out. include CSV export for SEs listing tenants with pin_exempt=true. credits: tiered (small/medium/large) based on tenant size if they opt into automated migration.

tina_engineering: orchestration edgecases: if canary passes but a downstream repo (e.g., reranker) is incompatible, promote should pause and mark 'integrations-failed'. we need a manual remediation path and SE-assist webhook. also ensure rate-limits on mass migrations.

opsbot: scheduled_migration tenant=acct-304 run_id=rr-4100000123 window=4100000500 status=queued.

rafael_pm: rollout pilot plan: pick 10 low-risk tenants (consented) and enable auto-migrate with conservative defaults for 4 weeks. success criteria: <1% support tickets per tenant about generation diffs, <2% latency regressions, and no failed migrations requiring manual rollback.

zoe_se: follow-ups: I'll prototype Console mockups and the hold/rollback UX.

marcus_research: I'll prepare the bench bundles + a lightweight 'diff preview' generator.

eden_support: I'll draft the email cadence + credit tiers and produce the contract exemption list.

tina_engineering: I'll produce an infra design doc with canary sizing heuristics, warmup replay strategy, and orchestration state machine.

rafael_pm: action owners noted. target to present pilot plan in next product sync. leaving thread for comments; please flag anything missing (observability hooks, SLO implications, legal checks). :eyes:
